teaser: A brief for an independent online English teacher: a loop around every lesson where agents draft and she decides, and a behaviour policy for every agent.
core_idea: An excellent independent English teacher runs everything around her lessons by hand. Agents could do most of it, but open-ended agents that email students or change her calendar would send her back to pen and paper. The brief gives her a site she owns, a loop around every lesson where agents draft and she decides, and an Agent Behaviour Policy for each of seven agents: no agent sends email, changes her calendar or refunds a payment. The plumbing is Workspace, Claude, GitHub, a private vault, Stripe and a reading meter. With it, she can publish every good explanation, build practice for each student on retrieval and spacing rather than learning styles, and map her teaching as a knowledge graph.
